summary: Marks the largest aggressive orders from the futures trade stream with bubbles, buyers above and sellers below.
overview: Big Trades (L1) is the Big Trades indicator for futures, fed by the futures trade stream (Data feed L1). It marks only the orders that stand out, as bubbles at their average price, sized by order size.
It is the Big Trades on NQ, ES, YM, GC, SI, CL and their micros. Crypto charts use Big Trades, which reads public exchange trades.
how: Fills on the same side within a short burst (150 ms gap, up to 4 ticks of price walk) are joined into one order. In Automatic mode the size threshold comes from the recorded trades for the symbol, so only unusually large orders show. Manual mode uses your own min and max size.
History comes from up to 48 hours of recorded trades; new trades arrive over the chart's shared connection.
use: Some traders watch where large orders appear near highs, lows or key levels.
Use two copies with different size bands to separate order sizes.
Hover a bubble to read its size.
notes: No longer in the Indicators window: futures order flow is now the (L2) tools, part of Pro. A saved chart that still holds this one is switched to Big Trades (L2) automatically.
Joining fills into one order is an estimate based on timing and price.
Futures only (NQ, ES, YM, RTY, CL, GC and their micros).
